auth_details: Read endpoints are public with no auth. Write/authenticated ops send a crates.io API token as the raw Authorization header value (not Bearer); Cargo credential providers handle this for publish/yank/owners.
rate_limits: 1 request per second. Prefer the sparse index, static CDN, or daily database dumps for bulk access.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right — Cargo Registry Web API states the Authorization header value is the API token itself, not Bearer (https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/registry-web-api.html). rate_limits: auditor right — data-access policy requires max 1 req/s and points bulk users to index/dumps (https://crates.io/data-access). example: auditor right — same page requires identifying User-Agent with contact; bare curl fails policy.
